title: Justin Ishbia - Lessons from Acquiring 586 Companies [Invest Like the Best, REPLAY]

reader_summary.headline: Today we are replaying my conversation with Justin Ishbia.
reader_summary.overview: Today we are replaying my conversation with Justin Ishbia. Justin is the Founding Partner of Shore Capital. Shore is a private equity firm that invests in microcap businesses within industry niches. With $7 billion in capital deployed but an average transaction size of just $12 million.

key_points.text: With $7 billion in capital deployed but an average transaction size of just $12 million.
The firm has created a moat around volume with nearly 600 acquisitions over the last three years.
We discuss identifying growth prospects, constructing a meaningful board, and the business mentality behind main street, not wall street, as Justin puts it.
